title: This is the kind of stunt casting that ABSOLUTELY WORKS ON ME! Can’t ...
transcript: I'm not gonna lie, I was nervous about the idea of six stunt casting, because so much of six as a concept is making sure that nobody really stands out above everybody else. And so this mix that they've brought together perfectly balances the cast. You have this really incredible mix of bringing back original cast members plus Jasmine Foresberg, who is a six veteran and arguably the most viral of the six veterans. And then you bring in your stunt cast with Dylan Mulvaney and Abigail Barlow, and I think their addition to this cast is perfect. This is great casting. Both of them are primarily known from social media. You know who else is primarily known from social media? 6 the musical. Dylan Mulvaney has years of theatre experience. I think the first time I saw her on stage was in 2020 in the book of Mormon tour before getting to see her star in her own show. So I am elated to see her making her Broadway debut. Abigail Barlow also has training in theatre. In fact, she went to theatre school for a good amount of her education, and it runs in the family because her sister is literally in ragtime right now. I really never should have doubted that they nailed this, but I think this is overall a great cast that keeps the balance that is so inherent to six as a musical. And I cannot wait to go back. It's been A while. I need to go back.
classificationReason: Creator reacts to the stunt casting announcement (Dylan Mulvaney, Abigail Barlow) for SIX. No first-hand attendance or review of the production — anticipation/casting news commentary.
